# Doxumentation & paperwork
The following forms should be available for use within Science:
- [bold]Combat Mech Authorization/Construction Form[/bold]: Documentation for combat mech construction. - [bold]Cyborg Chassis Transfer Record[/bold]: Documentation of chassis transfer, reasoning, prior and future chassis name. - [bold]Cyborg Conversion Form[/bold]: Records individual to be converted, the new chassis, authorization, and reasoning. - [bold]Cyborg/AI Conversion Consent Form[/bold]: Records explicit consent by crew member to be converted into a cyborg. - [bold]Item Request Form[/bold]: documentation of upgrades, distributed boards, and recipients. - [bold]Anomalous Host Consent Form[/bold]: written informed consent for crew hosting anomalies.
All forms should be filed promptly in departmental records and made available for review by the RD, Command, or Internal Affairs.
